controlPolicy.source: Notion fixed control card: 📌 공통 기준·워크플로우 v2
controlPolicy.rule: GPT public original-language/theological dictionary, academic DB, corpus, morphology and translation evidence review is the default next gate; Claude/Gemini are optional supplementary counter-audits and do not block continued research production.
controlPolicy.humanGate: only irreconcilable equal-strength evidence conflict, material existing-approved-meaning change, license/security/permission/cost/policy exception

decision: Preserve the exact-fingerprint GPT audit result as Evidence, continue per-target public-source synthesis, and use Claude/Gemini only as optional supplementary counter-audits when available. Do not promote or mutate production from this reconciliation step.
